# New renderings chosen in odyssey-089 (Odyssey 18.108–214)

Rows for the table in `conventions.md` (Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose).

| ὣς ἄρ’ ἔφαν, χαῖρεν δὲ κλεηδόνι δῖος Ὀδυσσεύς (whole-line reaction formula, 18.117; first half the table's ὣς φάν "So they spoke") | "So then they spoke, and rejoiced at the omen, heavenly Odysseus." | "So they spoke, and heavenly Odysseus rejoiced at the omen." | "was glad at the word", "was pleased by the saying" (lose κλεηδών), "Thus they spoke"; δῖος keeps the table's "heavenly" |
| κλεηδών (18.117, κλεηδόνι; a chance word heard as a sign, from κλέος "report") | "omen" | "omen" | "rumour", "report", "fame" (the κλέος words), "chance word" (explain in the note only), "sign" (keep for σῆμα) |
| κοσμήτωρ λαῶν (of Amphinomus, 18.152, κοσμήτορι λαῶν; from κοσμέω "arrange") | "the marshaller of the people" | "the marshal of the people" | "ruler" (reserved for κοίρανος), "leader of the people", "shepherd of the people" (reserved for ποιμὴν λαῶν), "chief of the people" (reserved for ὄρχαμος λαῶν) |
| ἀκιδνότερον (18.130, comparative of ἀκιδνός; derivation not known, sense "weak, insignificant"; already shipped as "slighter" at 5.217, odyssey-024, and 8.169, odyssey-034, so no new rendering; changed at review from "frailer") | "slighter" | "slighter" (+ note: derivation not known) | "frailer" (the drafted wording, withdrawn at review), "feebler" (ἄκικυς "feeble"), "weaker" (reserved for ἠπεδανός / ἀνάλκις), "more helpless", "more wretched" (reserved for δύστηνος) |
| ἀθεμίστιος (18.141, ἀνὴρ ἀθεμίστιος) | "lawless" | "lawless" | "unjust" (reserved for οὐ δίκαιος), "wicked", "godless"; the same English as ἀθέμιστος, the two words built alike on θέμις |
| ἀχρεῖον ἐγέλασσεν (18.163; ἀχρεῖον neuter as adverb, "uselessly, to no purpose") | "idly she laughed" | "gave an idle laugh" | "laughed mirthlessly", "laughed in vain", "laughed a weak laugh" (each picks a sense the word leaves open) |
| αἰνοπαθής (18.201, accusative αἰνοπαθῆ; αἰνός + the root of πάσχω) | "fearsomely suffering" | "so terribly afflicted" | "wretched" (reserved for δύστηνος), "much-suffering", "long-suffering" (turned down at πολύτλας); αἰνός keeps the table's "fearsome" |
| κῶμα (18.201, κῶμ’; "deep sleep, slumber") | "slumber" | "slumber" | "coma", "stupor", "sleep" (reserved for ὕπνος) |
| ἀγλαΐη (singular, of a person's beauty, 18.180, ἀγλαΐην; the plural ἀγλαΐαι "splendours" is already fixed, 17.244) | "splendour" | "beauty" | "finery", "glory", "radiance" (reserved elsewhere); `l` keeps the root-sense "splendour" (ἀγλαός), `i` the sense the line needs |
| κλιντήρ (18.190, ἐνὶ κλιντῆρι; a seat or couch to recline on, from κλίνω) | "couch" | "couch" | "chair" (reserved for θρόνος), "seat" (reserved for κλισμός), "bed" (reserved for λέχος and εὐνή); the same English as the guest-bed εὐνή "couch", the two words told apart by context |
| τέκος (vocative, of an old woman to a younger, 18.170) | "child" | "child" | "daughter", "my child", "dear" (φίλος), "girl" |
| ἔξοχος Ἀχαιῶν (18.205, ἔξοχος with partitive genitive; cf. the adverb ἔξοχα "beyond measure") | "stood out among the Achaeans" | "stood out among the Achaeans" | "outstanding" (reserved for ἀριπρεπής), "pre-eminent", "the foremost of the Achaeans" |
| χορὸν ἱμερόεντα (18.194, of the dance of the Graces) | "the dance … full of longing" | "a dance full of longing" | "lovely dance", "charming dance" (ἱμερόεις keeps "full of longing", as in ἱμερόεις γόος and ἔπεα ἱμερόεντα) |
| ἡ δ’ αὖ Τηλέμαχον προσεφώνεεν, ὃν φίλον υἱόν (whole-line speech introduction, 18.214; the possessive ὅς) | "And she in turn spoke to Telemachus, her own dear son:" | "And she in turn spoke to Telemachus, her own dear son:" | "addressed" (reserved for προσέειπε / προσέφη), "answered" (reserved for ἠμείβετο), "his dear son"; προσεφώνεεν keeps "spoke to", as shipped in odyssey-014, -023, -036 |
